name: CRH
description: CRH calls itself the leading provider of building materials for modernizing infrastructure, with $37.4B of 2025 revenue, $7.7B of Adjusted EBITDA and 3,961 locations. It digs and sells aggregates (crushed stone, sand), makes cement, readymixed concrete and asphalt, and paves roads, and it makes engineered products such as pipe, precast structures, fencing, utility enclosures and outdoor living products. Customers are road and infrastructure agencies, utilities, contractors and homebuilders; it has done more than 1,250 acquisitions and buys fragmented local businesses then connects them. Roughly 45% of revenue is Americas materials, 19% Americas building products and 36% Europe and Australia.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label as shown in Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (sector and sub-industry columns only; that list does not give industry group or industry). Read 2026-09-30.

hq.note: Stonemason's Way, Rathfarnham, Dublin 16. Primary listing NYSE, secondary London Stock Exchange

businessLines.name: Americas Materials Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells heavy materials by the ton or cubic yard to public road and infrastructure agencies and private builders, and earns service revenue paving and building; local quarries give pricing power because the product is costly to haul.
businessLines.description: Aggregates, cementitious materials, readymixed concrete, asphalt, plus paving and construction services in North America.

businessLines.name: Americas Building Solutions
businessLines.how: Manufactures products specified into projects (pipe, precast, utility enclosures, fencing, pavers) and sells them to contractors and distributors, one-time sales tied to project starts.
businessLines.description: Highly specified engineered products for transportation, water, energy and telecom projects, reindustrialization (manufacturing, data centers) and outdoor living.

businessLines.name: International Solutions
businessLines.how: Same mix of aggregates, cement, concrete and products sold into local construction and renovation markets, with cyclical demand and energy costs affecting margins.
businessLines.description: Building materials, products and services across Western and Eastern Europe and Australia.
